messages:
emma-pm: Scheduled tenant slice handoff for client 'HarborQ' — planned traffic shift 23:00 UTC tonight. Need final quick ack and confirm rollback windows.

riley-sre: ack from SRE side. We'll monitor 5xx and tail latency. Rollback trigger: >3% 5xx over 5m or p95 latency increase >200ms vs baseline.

ben-release: version pin: v2.14.1 (model-serve: rwd-serve-3.2.0). No schema changes. Release notes snippet below:

```release
- Serving runtime: mitigate kvcache cold-start bug
- Autoscaler tuning: reduce surge headroom for dedicated slices
- Retry policy: conservative 429 backoff
```

emma-pm: thanks. @deploybot queued canary slice to 10% for 10m then ramp to 50% if green.

deploybot: Canary started on slice harborq-canary-01. image: rwd/serve:3.2.0, config: batch=64, kvcaching=enabled. Monitoring: /dashboards/harborq-rollout

alice-eng: quick note — we've added a temporary prefix-cache warmup for top 20 prefixes to reduce initial tail latency.

riley-sre: adding runbook snippet: if p95 > 700ms or >5% errors, pause traffic and roll back to v2.13.9 via `rd-deploy rollback --tenant harborq --to v2.13.9`

ben-release: confirmation — v2.13.9 is on standby and KMS keys unchanged. No schema migration needed.

emma-pm: all approvals (pm, eng, sre). @deploybot proceed with canary.

deploybot: Canary ramp complete: 10% -> 10% hold. Next automated check in 10m. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/harborq/canary

riley-sre: watching. will post final after 10m. :eyes:

(10 minutes later)

riley-sre: canary metrics look good. 5xx=0.02% (baseline 0.03%), p95 latency +15ms. Proceeding to 50% ramp. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Ramp to 50% initiated. Safety-net: automatic rollback on triggers above.

emma-pm: copy. leaving this thread open for rollback decision. If anything odd, call out and we'll abort.

ben-release: added to release notes: "HarborQ dedicated: rollout v2.14.1 — performance fixes; enable prefix warmup". Pushing final artifact to docs site.

alice-eng: FYI I'll follow up with an infra PR to adjust batch=64->56 if GPU utilization spikes beyond 85%.

riley-sre: noted. if util >85% for 5m during ramp, pause and rollback.

emma-pm: thanks everyone. closing after full 50% hold and no triggers. Will post a short release snippet to #announcements when done.
